description.value: A prospective multimodal structural MRI study investigated white matter and gray matter correlates of risk and recovery from post-trauma anhedonia in recently traumatized individuals.

spans.text: The present prospective study investigated neural correlates of risk and recovery from PTA in a sample of recently traumatized individuals recruited from the ED.

description.value: Prospective longitudinal observational study of recently traumatized individuals recruited from an emergency department, with MRI and psychometric assessment around 1 month and at 12 months after trauma.

spans.text: A key gap in our understanding of the neurostructural correlates of PTA is the lack of longitudinal data assessing both changes in PTA and how these changes correspond with change in white matter pathways over time.
